messages:
Harper (People Ops): Quick sync: launching a brief handbook amendment called 'Manager attestations for schedule exceptions' + a 10-min compliance micro-training. Need: two quick reviewers for wording, one owner to run RSVP/completion tracking, and a note for localization/legal on country-specific clauses. Target publish: 2026-05-12.

Ravi: I can review wording. Is this changing any benefits language?

Harper (People Ops): No benefits changes. This is about managers documenting approvals for exceptions (duration + reason) and a short ack.

Sofia (Legal): I'll review EU/UK/DE text. Quick flag: in Germany we should require a documented expected duration if remote > 2 weeks. I'll drop suggested text after seeing draft.

Tae (Localization): We can translate once the final strings are frozen. Heads up: avoid colloquial phrases like "flex credits".

Ned: I can own the tracker and handle automations (RSVP + completion receipts). What's the CSV schema?

Harper (People Ops): Use this CSV header exactly (for export automations):
```csv
manager_name,team,email,attested(yes/no),attestation_ts,training_session,verifier,notes
```
We rely on the email column for automated receipts and the exact order for nightly exports.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled — RSVP ping 7 days before first session and completion nudge 48 hours before publish date.

Ravi: Wording pass done; I moved the "manager must record duration" sentence earlier and added a short example: "e.g., 2-week remote to cover family care while on parental leave" to clarify intent.

Sofia (Legal): Reviewed. Minor edit for DE/FR: add a line that workplace risk assessments may be required if remote work exceeds local thresholds. No legal blockers otherwise.

Tae (Localization): Good to translate after Harper confirms. I can turn around FR/DE/ES strings in 48 hours.

Ned: I'll create the sheet and seed managers from eng/product. I'll set automations to send a PDF receipt to the email column and export nightly to the compliance bucket.

Harper (People Ops): Action items: 1) Ravi finalize wording today; 2) Sofia legal localization review by 2026-05-02; 3) Tae prepare translations after final text; 4) Ned build tracker + automations by 2026-05-05; 5) Harper publish 2026-05-12 and run two 15-min drop-ins (2026-05-05 & 2026-05-10). I'll post the PR link here.

Ned: PR link please and I'll pre-seed tracker.

Harper (People Ops): PR opened: https://git.company/handbook/policies/manager-attestations-2026 — please add quick reviews. Thanks! :raised_hands:

PeopleOpsBot: Note: managers must use the exact CSV header ordering to ensure exports/SLAs function correctly.
